column6: A person is entitled to Pension Age Winter Heating Payment for the qualifying week exactly when all of the following hold: the person has reached pensionable age before or on a day in the qualifying week; the person satisfies the residence condition; the person is not excluded by reg. 9; the person is not regarded as having been awarded a winter fuel payment for the week; it is not the case that the person is the applicant, made an application for Pension Age Winter Heating Payment for the qualifying week and did not make the application in time under reg. 16B.
